comparator.sourceNotes: The official prospective year pages give 60+60+60=180 EC and explicitly mark the 2026–27 overviews as provisional. Year one lists 52 EC compulsory university courses plus the required 8-EC Bachelorstage 1. Year two lists 48 EC university courses, required 8-EC Bachelorstage 2 and 4 EC genuine academic choice; Analyse 3 is one optional example. Year three lists 31 EC university courses including the 10-EC bachelor thesis, required 7-EC Bachelorstage 3 and 10-EC Afstudeerstage, plus 12 EC genuine academic choice; three named orthopedagogical/professional 4-EC courses are optional instances, not universal requirements. Total required credited primary-school placements are 8+8+7+10=33 EC. The prospectus says graduates receive a bachelor degree with primary-teaching qualification, while the selected ordinary route includes subject didactics, classroom management and final supervised independent teaching. The 0-EC RADAr assessment is excluded. Concurrent prospectus year pages do not guarantee a fixed three-year entrant-cohort schedule.

routeSelection.route: Pedagogische Wetenschappen van Primair Onderwijs, ordinary three-year teaching-qualification route
routeSelection.basis: The target is the single ordinary PWPO bachelor rather than the distinct Pedagogical Sciences or ALPO programme. The 4-EC and 12-EC open choices remain open; optional Analyse 3 and orthopedagogy electives are not imposed as a specialization. All four compulsory placements remain present.

exception.reason: PWPO is an integrated academic primary-teacher-education degree that confers primary-school teaching qualification. The core includes 33 EC in four supervised classroom placements, direct instruction, classroom management and pedagogical practice, plus sustained subject didactics in early reading, handwriting, spelling, speaking and writing, reading comprehension and literature, mathematics, world orientation, art and multilingual learning. UCR offers an academic cluster in development, cognition, psychology, research and society, and one communication project with primary-school pupils, but no sequence in primary subject didactics, classroom management, sustained supervised teaching or teacher qualification. A coherent 24-course developmental-psychology programme could respond to some child-development interests, but would omit the defining teaching practice and profession-specific academic preparation of this named degree. It cannot be presented as its closest defensible UCR response.
exception.curriculumContext: Radboud’s three provisional 2026–27 year overviews reconcile to 180 EC with 33 EC of credited teacher placements and 16 EC of truly optional academic choice. The exception is based on absent teacher-education content, not missing evidence for the credit total or the fact of a regulated qualification alone. The earlier ALPO comparison has a different structure: a 120-EC pedagogical-sciences university core and a separate 60-EC primary-teacher-education exemption; that larger pedagogical-sciences core gives UCR materially more common academic ground than the PWPO teaching route.
exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Reviewed all 151 enriched current UCR course rows, including titles, description2, outline-derived profiles, prerequisites, planned terms, disciplinary topics and methods. HCBPSYC314 Lifespan Developmental Psychology, HCBGATE102 Introduction to Brain & Behavior, HCBCOGN312 Psycholinguistics, HCBPSYC212 Abnormal Psychology and HCBPSYC312 Psychodiagnostics & Psychotherapies genuinely address child development, learning or support at a broader level. BENGATE102 Research Methods & Statistics and HCBPSYC211 Statistics & Experimental Methods can support inquiry about children. MCCCOMM213 Rhetoric in Action involves a project teaching primary-school pupils persuasive speaking, but it is one 7.5-EC communication course, not a supervised multi-year classroom placement or a programme in literacy, numeracy and other primary-subject didactics. The workbook contains no dedicated teacher-training, primary classroom-management or supervised teaching-practice sequence; combining the related psychology and communication courses would not supply the programme’s professional academic core.
